test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: An item was sold at Rs. 5,474 after two successive discounts of 12.5% and 8% were offered on its Marked Price. What was the Marked Price (in Rs.) of the item?
solution:
GIVEN:

The selling price is Rs 5474

Successive discounts are 12.5% and 8%

FORMULA USED:

S.P. = (1 - d1/100 ) × ( 1- d2/100) × M.P.

Where, S.P. = Selling price , M.P. = Marked price ,

d1 and d2 are successive discount percent respectively 

CALCULATION:

We know that,

S.P. = ( 1- d1/100 ) × ( 1- d2/100) × M.P. 

⇒ 5474 = ( 1- 12.5/100 ) × ( 1 - 8/100) × M.P. 

⇒ 5474 = 7/8 × 23/25 × M.P. 

⇒ M.P = 8 × 25 × 34 

⇒ M.P. = 6800

Hence, the Marked Price of an article is Rs 6800.
